final: WITH patient_averages AS (SELECT l.ID, p.SEX, AVG(l.ALB - l.TP) AS albumin_protein, AVG(l.APTT - l.PT) AS aptt_pt FROM Laboratory AS l JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = l.ID GROUP BY l.ID, p.SEX), sex_averages AS (SELECT SEX, AVG(albumin_protein) AS albumin_protein, AVG(aptt_pt) AS aptt_pt FROM patient_averages GROUP BY SEX), overall_average AS (SELECT AVG(aptt_pt) AS aptt_pt FROM sex_averages) SELECT AVG(s.albumin_protein), AVG(s.aptt_pt), AVG(s.aptt_pt - o.aptt_pt) FROM sex_averages AS s CROSS JOIN overall_average AS o WHERE o.aptt_pt IS NOT NULL AND s.aptt_pt > o.aptt_pt
